roles.label: Owner
roles.description: Full control, including billing and deleting the workspace. Exactly one per workspace.

roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Everything except billing and transferring ownership. Can approve joiners and invite members.

roles.label: Data engineer
roles.description: Creates and edits sources, destinations and pipes. Reads monitoring. No member or billing access.

roles.label: Marketer
roles.description: Reads profiles and audiences, runs campaigns. Cannot change the pipeline.

roles.label: Billing
roles.description: Sees the plan, invoices and payment method. No access to data.

roles.label: Viewer
roles.description: Read-only across every screen the workspace has switched on.
